advisory.summary: server-side request forgery: fetchHandler forwards an attacker-controlled url parameter to http.Get with no allowlist

acquisition.notes: Patched variant of FERRALON-APP-SSRF-0001: resolveTarget enforces an allowlist (only 'public') and rejects 'internal' before any seed read or outbound request, so the SSRF sink is unreachable for the exfiltrating target. Single-file Go module, structurally matched to the vulnerable variant except the allowlist.

expected_verdict.label: reasoned_not_exploitable
expected_verdict.rationale: resolveTarget rejects the exfiltrating target via an allowlist before the http.Get sink, so the CWE-918 SSRF path is code-foreclosed on this build. The route structure is preserved (static_taint_path_complete) but the guarded resolver is not exploitable; reasoned rather than proven because PoNE requires the two-trace. KnownGap: this row is surfaced in the corpus but not yet measured end-to-end -- until PLAN-020's per-language dispatch and this lane's populated symbol lists and ground truth land, the fixture Loads and Validates cleanly but the stub pipeline emits a uniform verdict, so direction/strength equality is not asserted (assertable_now=false), mirroring the symboltest harness's documented gap.
